findings: contextDone/contextErr translates raw context errors only where explicitly invoked; not a global invariant over all errors.

expandSeriesSet may return ctx.Err or iterator error directly. checkAndExpandSeriesSet returns that error; selected evaluator caller wraps with expanding series and errWithWarnings. Recovery extracts wrapped error rather than converting it into ErrQueryTimeout.
Instant evaluation error is returned immediately and skips the success-only final context check. This explains a source-supported route to execution classification for raw expansion deadline errors.
queryConstructionError recognizes specific typed limit/timeout/canceled errors, otherwise bad query parameter; raw deadline/canceled alone is not identical to typed construction timeout/cancel.

observeQueryRejection increments max_duration only if error.As ErrQueryTimeout AND context.Cause matches errQueryCostDuration. Raw wrapped deadline execution error does not satisfy the selected typed check.
respondError uses optional overrideErrorCode and JSON marshaling/writing can fail. Default code mapping is conditional, not every deployed response guarantee.
existing_documentation_disposition: The selected docs distinction usual timeout503 versus possible expanding-series execution422 is supported by the inspected paths. Preserve qualifiers usually/can. Do not generalize all duration errors, raw contexts or custom engines to503; do not invent exact measured timing.
